description: Complete evaluation of the frozen exploratory RPC-residual correction, not original-paper score reproduction
rules: No model, seed, weight or candidate-count selection using test results; all fixed variants are reported.
AIOps uses 102 training and 26 test incidents; frozen TT-selected correction hyperparameters are transferred directly.
TrainTicket uses original 108 train, 12 validation and 30 test incidents; its cohort has already been explored.
No-traces ablation removes RPC residual evidence and trace-valued features as well as the trace encoder; dependency topology remains available.
No-metrics and no-logs ablations remove their features from both the base model and evidence corrector.
The primary new method uses a supervised evidence ranker, not LLM generation. Historical LLM results are contextual references only, not a fresh matched baseline for AIOps paper128.
Industrial PM and external published baselines are outside this run.
